thread:
nina: heads-up: onboarding hiccup on WSL2. installed redwoodctl on Windows, then tried from WSL bash. `redwoodctl auth login` opened browser and callback succeeded but the CLI failed at credential helper stage with `permission denied`.
omar: can you paste the error?
nina: sure:
```
$ redwoodctl auth login
Opening browser for authentication...
Callback received.
Saving credential via helper: /mnt/c/Users/nina/.local/share/redwood/redwood-credential-helper.exe
failed: exec: "/mnt/c/Users/nina/.local/share/redwood/redwood-credential-helper.exe": permission denied
No profiles found after login
```
kevin: ah classic WSL interop issue. Windows exe paths show up under /mnt/c, but Linux kernel still enforces no-exec if file has no +x or metadata prevents exec. Also some mounts set noexec by default.
nina: I hadn't noticed the file mode. `ls -l /mnt/c/Users/nina/.local/share/redwood/` shows the exe but with -rw-r--r--. Trying to `chmod +x` on /mnt/c doesn't change it.
omar: two things: 1) we shouldn't call the Windows helper from WSL unless we intentionally support that mode. 2) fallback should be to the linux helper or write a flatfile if helper not executable.
kevin: quick workaround: run `redwoodctl auth login` from PowerShell (Windows side) so the helper runs natively, or set env `REDWOOD_CLI_CRED_HELPER=flatfile` in WSL before login.
nina: `export REDWOOD_CLI_CRED_HELPER=flatfile` worked, login finished and profile saved under `~/.config/redwood/profiles.json` in WSL.
omar: filing a small DX fix: detect when credential helper path is on a noexec mount and surface a clear error with suggested workarounds (PowerShell, use flatfile or install Linux helper). Also fallback automatically to flatfile if exec fails with EPERM/ENOEXEC and warn.
kevin: also add a note in the WSL onboarding doc: explain cross-OS helper pitfalls and env overrides. Add an integration test in our WSL runner to ensure exe-on-mnt-c failure yields useful guidance.
ina: @devex-bot can you create an issue and tag eng-platform + docs?
devex-bot: created issue #8991 "wsl: credential helper on /mnt/c may be non-executable; detect and fallback with clearer message" and added labels `devex:auth`, `platform:wsl`.
infra-bot: suggested telemetry event (opt-in) for credential-helper exec failures to track how often WSL users hit this.
omar: thanks all. I'll draft the error text: "Credential helper at {path} not executable from WSL. Run login from Windows, set REDWOOD_CLI_CRED_HELPER=flatfile, or install the Linux helper. See https://redwood.dev/wsl-troubleshoot".
nina: adding the workaround to the onboarding checklist and the support KB. much appreciated! :raised_hands:
